Weird, I can't start an app that has the name `push`.
Well internally in the PM2 daemon, by calling your application "push" it overrides the .push function of the Array object ^^
Just rename your application with another name than _push_

This is kind of a ridiculous fix, I can't create apps that include the word "push" anywhere in them?  Seems excessive.. I have been trying to debug an opsworks failure, and I just came across this error.  I tried to create an app with the name "soxhub-api-nspusherqa"  note the word push being in the middle of the string... why would that be forbidden?  I can understand checking for an app named explicitly "push" or even with the prefix "push", but why can't I use it in the middle of the app name?

Just can't use name equals 'push'.
I rename my 'push' to 'pushService', and it works well.

issue.title: Fix incorrect array check

repository.name: cli-table
repository.description: Pretty unicode tables for the CLI with Node.JS

issue.body:
`Array.isArray()` is used for checking properties - it's more correct and allows using of `length` and other `Array` method names to be used as keys in data to be rendered.

@Automattic @rauchg This is a blocker of Unitech/PM2#1764, please, review it as soon as possible.

issue.body:
Not allowed "push", "my_push", etc....

from [issue 1764](https://github.com/Unitech/pm2/issues/1764) it seems you can't call your application "push" but there is no reason given to block every other application name containing the letters "push".

I will do a PR to change this if there is a chance it will be merged.
